title: 比 (bǐ) Comparisons in Chinese: HSK 2 Grammar with Examples
description: How to compare with 比 (bǐ) in Chinese: A 比 B + adjective, why 很 can't go in, saying how much, negatives with 没有, and 13 HSK 2 examples.
h1: How to Compare Two Things with 比
lede: 比 (bǐ) is the everyday way to say that one thing is bigger, colder, cheaper or better than another. The pattern is short, but it has two rules that learners often break: no 很 before the adjective, and no 不 for the negative.

sections.h2: The pattern: A 比 B + adjective
paras: A + 比 + B + adjective. Read it as "A, compared with B, is ...". The adjective comes at the end, and there is no word for "more": 我比他高 already means "I am taller than him".
A and B should be the same kind of thing. To compare my phone with yours, say 我的手机比你的新; the 的 at the end stands for 手机, so you don't need to repeat it.

examples.en: This one is cheaper than that one.

examples.py: Wǒ de shǒujī bǐ nǐ de xīn.
examples.en: My phone is newer than yours.

sections.h2: No 很, but you can say how much
paras: The most common mistake is to put 很 or 非常 before the adjective, as in 他比我很高. With 比 the adjective stands on its own: 他比我高.
To say how big the difference is, add something after the adjective: 一点儿 for "a bit", 多了 or 得多 for "much", or an exact amount such as 三岁. To say "even more", put 还 before the adjective.

examples.en: He's a bit taller than me.

examples.zh: 坐飞机比坐火车快多了。
examples.py: Zuò fēijī bǐ zuò huǒchē kuài duō le.
examples.en: Flying is much faster than going by train.

examples.zh: 这个房间比那个大得多。
examples.py: Zhège fángjiān bǐ nàge dà de duō.
examples.en: This room is much bigger than that one.

examples.py: Gēge bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
examples.en: My older brother is three years older than me.
Today is even hotter than yesterday.

paras: To say "A is not as ... as B", use 没有 instead of 比: A + 没有 + B + adjective. You can add 那么 before the adjective, meaning "as ... as that". Don't say 我比他不高.
For a yes-or-no question, add 吗 at the end of a 比 sentence.

examples.en: I'm not as tall as him.
Today isn't as hot as yesterday.

paras: To compare actions, use a verb with 得 and put 比 either before the verb or after 得. Both word orders are correct and mean the same.

examples.py: Tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài.
Tā bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài.

worksheet.title: 比 Comparisons Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 比 comparisons worksheet for HSK 2: 20 exercises (比 or 没有, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 比 or 没有 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: I'm taller than him.
This one isn't as tasty as that one.
Today is a bit colder than yesterday.
My room isn't as big as yours.
Going by train isn't as fast as flying.
His Chinese is much better than mine.
This top isn't as expensive as that one.
He runs faster than me.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: My younger brother is taller than me.
This one is a bit cheaper than that one.
answers: 这个比那个便宜一点儿。

items.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
My older brother is three years older than me.
He runs faster than me.
Flying is much faster than going by train.
answers: 坐飞机比坐火车快多了。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: He is taller than me.
Today is much hotter than yesterday.
I'm not as tall as him.
I'm two years older than him.
Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
He is a bit taller than me.
